content: Both packages were prepared for real npm publishing: package.json for @davindermahal/context-schema and @davindermahal/documentation-mcp each gained `files: ["dist"]`, a `repository` field pointing at github.com/davindermahal/ai-intake-documentation-mcp (with the correct `directory` subpath), and `publishConfig: {access: "public"}` (needed since both are scoped packages). Versions bumped 0.1.0 -> 0.1.1 for both. Each package also gained its own README.md (install/usage-facing, distinct from the root repo README and from .ai/docs). Root README.md gained a "Kicking off documentation" section documenting the new start_documentation slash command.
